thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased container restarts for svc/model-infer-prod-rt-0. Observed 5 restarts in 3m, exit reason: GPU OOM during prefill. Routing impact: ~12% 5xx on /v1/generate. Paging @ml-oncall.

alice: looking into logs now. seeing repeated: `CUDA out of memory when allocating 1.2GiB` inside prefill path. stack trace points to prefill_batcher -> allocate_kv_cache.

ben: oncall infra - are nodes flapping or just containers? metrics show nodeCPU stable, GPU memory pressure spikes. might be a particular container getting very large prefill sequences.

carol: digging into request traces. Found a few requests with extremely large system prompts + user message lengths — one with ~1.2M tokens (client bug?). It's hitting our prefill which tries to allocate KV for entire context.

ml-oncall: I’m taking this. first action: enable prefill-size-sanitizer on the service to reject requests > 200k tokens and fall back to streaming prefill. Applying now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: feature-flag prefill-size-sanitizer -> svc/model-infer-prod-rt-0 (canary).

alice: logs after toggle: sanitizer rejecting a handful of extreme requests (status 413). number of container restarts dropped from 5/3m to 0/10m on canary.

ben: I'm going to cordon node gpu-node-4 that showed the highest OOMs and drain gracefully to force redistribution. scheduling drain now: `kubectl drain gpu-node-4 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

carol: filed a rate-limit/validation patch on the client that seems to be origin of the 1.2M token request. contacting partner engineering to confirm whether this was an accidental upload.

support-jane: Customer impact check: support logs show EnterpriseCustomerX got ~15% of requests failing between 16:18-16:29 UTC. Many were prefill-heavy. I've opened a support ticket and sent a mitigation note.

ml-oncall: mitigation summary so far: 1) enabled sanitizer fallback -> rejects extreme prefill bodies and routes to streaming; 2) cordoned problematic node; 3) canary shows restarts stopped. Next: rollback to global after validation window. Also push temporary model-fallback policy to route oversized contexts to smaller quantized model to reduce per-request memory.

alice: here's a short snippet from the OOM log for trace:

```
2026-03-15T16:16:42Z model-infer[pid=4321] ERROR: allocate_kv_cache failed: CUDA runtime error (2): out of memory at /src/runtime/prefill.cc:189
Stack: prefill_batcher.cpp:142 allocate_kv_cache -> transformer.cc:92 prefill_step
Last request id: req_0a9f3b7
Input tokens: 1,243,098
```

ben: we should add an alert rule: GPU_PREFILL_OOM count > 3 in 5m for any deployment -> page ml-oncall + eng-sre. also add a runbook link.

carol: rolling global config now: prefill-size-sanitizer enabled with thresholds: max_prefill_tokens=200000, action=fallback_to_streaming. patch diff:

```
service.runtime.prefill_limits:
  max_prefill_tokens: 200000
  overflow_action: streaming_fallback
  log_level: warn
```

ml-oncall: applied global flag at 16:28 UTC. monitoring.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: attempted burst by 2 replicas due to CPU/GPU pressure; one pod failed restart attempts and was evicted by kubelet after OOM.

alice: after sanitizer + node drain + model-fallback, observed: 5xx rate for /v1/generate down from 12% -> 0.8% over 10m, container restarts = 0 in last 12m on affected pool.

support-jane: update to EnterpriseCustomerX ticket: "We've implemented a temporary safeguard to reject extremely large requests and routed heavy contexts to a lower-memory model. If you saw errors around 16:18-16:29 UTC, please retry — we expect normal behavior now. We're tracking a client-originated malformed request and will share details once confirmed."

ben: follow-ups: schedule a post-incident config change to make sanitizer default, add alert for prefill OOMs, and add a circuit-breaker that automatically routes oversized prefill to quantized model before allocation.

carol: created GH issue infra/serving#1427 with root-cause notes and link to the offending client request sample. tagging client-security to scrub any PII before sharing externally.

ml-oncall: marking incident as mitigated at 16:36 UTC. Remaining tasks: postmortem (owner: carol), remediation list (owner: ben), customer comms follow-up (owner: support-jane).

alice: quick note for the postmortem: add a short section on adding a prefill allocation safety margin and reviewing KV cache growth heuristics for extreme token churn.

support-jane: will follow up with EnterpriseCustomerX and invite them to a post-incident call if they request further details.

incident-bot: Incident MITIGATED: svc/model-infer-prod-rt-0. Duration: ~18 minutes. Severity: SEV3 (customer-facing errors, limited downtime). Links: infra/serving#1427, support/TICKET-9876. :white_check_mark:

ml-oncall: Thanks team. we'll run the RCA tomorrow 10:00 UTC and capture action items. good job on quick mitigation.
